title: Three Autumns and One Short Porch
subtitle: 家庭生活 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 家庭生活（人与自我·生活与学习·个人、家庭、社区及学校生活）
meta: 主题语境：家庭生活（人与自我·生活与学习·个人、家庭、社区及学校生活）　|　核心词汇：house　|　正文 344 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 house 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1973 the carpenter ① built the house that no tenant in the terrace would have described, and he said the building was the whole of the October. The ② house, meaning the building itself and not the porch, ran three Octobers and stayed undescribed in the book; a house, he said, is the only thing in a terrace that is judged by how long it is left undescribed.

Every ③ house in that terrace had the same short porch beside it, and the ④ house at the far chimney, meaning the room they kept for the children to choose and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever thanked twice. A house, my mother said, is nine parts patience and one part somebody willing to describe; the carpenter said the describing is the part that fills three Octobers.

My uncle meant the other thing entirely: he said ⑤ the house was the whole of the matter, meaning the home and not the building. The ⑥ house, meaning the home and not any of that, is the only thing in a matter that everybody waits for and nobody describes; house, he said, is either something you build or the only word that means both a building and a home. He said the home is the part they remember.

By 1978 the ⑦ house had become a line in a deed, and the deed had become an argument about the short porch. The ⑧ house of the whole thing, the carpenter wrote in January, was one terrace and three Octobers of describing; house, he said, is either the room at the far chimney or the reason you learned to describe. He said the describing was never mentioned.

The ⑨ house I remember is the building described in the deed, which closed in 1980 and is still described as the quietest in the terrace. A ⑩ house, my mother said in 1982, is the only building that improves by being described; every house, she said, is a home that has agreed to look like a building. She said the home was the honest half.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: A. n. 房子；住宅（指排屋里每一栋旁边的那一栋）
B. n. 房子；住宅（指那栋房屋本身，与门廊相对）
C. 固定搭配：build the house 盖一栋房子
D. n. 房子；住宅（指留给孩子们挑的那一间那一栋）
E. n. 屋事（抽象总称，指一处排屋的房子之事）
F. n. 房子；住宅（指房契里写到、被记下的的那一栋）
G. n. 家、安身之处（指一件事里人人都住却无人提起的那样东西）
H. n. 安身之处（抽象总称，指人人都住却无人提起的那样东西）

items.q: built the house that no tenant in the terrace would have described
The house, meaning the building itself and not the porch
the house at the far chimney
the house was the whole of the matter
the house had become a line in a deed
The house of the whole thing
A house, my mother said in 1982

answers.why: build the house 意为“盖一栋房子”，1973 年那位木匠把排屋里没有一位房客肯描述的一栋房子做了一遍。
house 意为“房子；住宅”，指那栋房屋本身而不是门廊，它经过了三个十月而在簿子上没有被描述。
house 意为“房子；住宅”，指排屋里每一栋旁边的那一栋，每一栋旁边都有同一道窄窄的门廊。
house 意为“房子；住宅”，指最远那座烟囱留给孩子们挑的那一间那一栋，是唯一有人谢过两次的。
house 意为“家、安身之处”，指一件事里人人都住却无人提起的那样东西，叔叔说这个家就是那件事的全部。
house 意为“安身之处”，指人人都住却无人提起的那样东西而不是那栋房屋，是事情里人人都等、却无人说破的东西。
house 意为“房子；住宅”，指房契里写到、被记下的的那一栋，到 1978 年这一栋成了房契里的一行。
house 意为“屋事”，木匠一月写道，整件事的房子之事是一处排屋和三个十月的描述。
house 意为“房子；住宅”，我记得的是房契里描述过的那一栋，1980 年过户了，至今仍被说成排屋里最安静的一栋。
house 为抽象总称，母亲 1982 年说，房子是唯一会因为被好好描述而变得更好的房屋。
